items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (ribs) DNP second straight day Thursday, making it unlikely he plays Sunday vs Raiders. Worked with trainer on side.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1 hit; consecutive DNPs.
items.implication: Sit if available elsewhere; slot role disruption.
items.opportunity: Top target for Herbert pre-injury (5-82-1 Week 1).

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) was a non-participant Thursday one day after injuring it in practice; doctors do not view it as serious (Grade 1 strain) but Week 2 status vs Bengals is in jeopardy. Missed five games with hammy in 2024.
items.why: Hamstring injury Wed practice; Grade 1 confirmed; history of multi-game absences.
items.implication: High-end WR2 risk; monitor Friday practice. If OUT, targets cascade to Boutte/Hutchinson/Noel/Schultz.
items.opportunity: 37/42 routes Week 1 on Stroud dropbacks signals massive prior role.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday (second straight). Ja'Kobi Lane (fractured wrist) on IR/return. If Flowers out, hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated Week 1; consecutive missed practices.
items.implication: WR1 risk vs Saints; Bateman primary beneficiary if OUT.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers DNP again Thursday due to last week's knee (meniscus trim) surgery; has yet to practice since. Earlier reports of realistic W2/3 chance and 'not overly serious'.
items.why: Meniscus trim pre-W1; no practice this week.
items.implication: TE1 risk; Mayer elevated if OUT again. Same knee as prior PCL/bone bruise.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) full practice, says 'ready to go' for Week 2 vs Steelers after missing opener. Complements Stevenson.
items.why: Ankle healed; full participant and self-declared ready.
items.implication: RB committee returns; both flex-viable, Stevenson volume dips.
items.opportunity: Explosive change-of-pace/goal-line potential; reverse prior Stevenson full workload.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 24% target share (team lead tie) and 21/24 RB touches through 3Q Week 1 (74% snaps). RB1 overall in range of outcomes if healthy. Smash vs IND (gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry).
items.why: Elite Week 1 usage + soft matchup + preseason RB1 upside talk.
items.opportunity: 24% tgt share, high snap/touch share, receiving work.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: Utilization Score 99 in Week 1 (tied Bijan for league lead). 19% career tgt share recent; 25+ touches frequent. Overreaction to injury scare.
items.why: Elite utilization under Kubiak; volume secure.

items.text: ETR W2 Waiver injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; A.J. Brown=Romeo Doubs; De'Zhaun Stribling=Deebo Samuel; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller (reverse if plays); plus Devaughn Vele, etc. Streaming options listed.
items.why: Precise role/injury fallout mapping for adds.
items.implication: Prioritize Harris/Bateman/Deebo/Vele on waivers; FAAB guidance.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow limited participant second consecutive day due to back injury.
items.implication: Monitor for full clearance; Chase/Higgins/Brown usage stable if plays.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE despite tough Week 1: 27% target share, 13.7 aDOT with deep looks. TEN allows high catch rate/YPR; bounceback expected.
Travis Etienne HATE: Matched Kendre Miller rushes Week 1; 69% fantasy pts via air. Kamara expected back further squeezes role; underdog script vs BAL not run-friendly.
corroboration: ETR: Kamara=Miller reverse if out but Kamara plays

items.text: Dalton Kincaid LOVE: 69% route participation (highest any game last season), 77% snaps (highest since 2024 W9). Efficient per-target; breakout if healthy role sticks. DET soft vs TEs.
items.why: Surging route/snap rates signal expanded role.

items.text: Colston Loveland 89% route participation (highest TE Week 1). 0 points frustrating but missed throws (incl end zone); buy if owner panics. Elite opportunity.
items.why: League-high TE routes in high-scoring Bears offense.

items.text: Nico Collins 37/42 routes Week 1; hammy history key for MRI. Kenyon Sadiq (debut): 28 snaps, schemed goal-line carry + screen + targets despite limited practice history—clear intent to feature.
items.why: Route dominance + rookie goal-line scheme signals.
items.implication: Collins massive when healthy; Sadiq stash/handcuff upside for goal-line.
